note: Kanabec County has no countywide zoning; zoning is set by its cities and townships. Mora publishes its zoning map only as a static print file (zoning-map-march-2020) and its code names districts without a GIS layer; Knife Lake Township publishes a zoning map PDF. Braham and Ogilvie have no zoning service found. ArcGIS searches turned up only Braham parcel/city-limit layers (no zoning districts), and the Schneider parcel WFS did not respond. No queryable zoning district polygons were found for the county or its cities.
